resolved.changelog:
Fixes:
- Fully fixed a bug when 1.21.1+ did not show anything with GL4ES
- Other minor launcher crash fixes
Technical changes:
- Refactored screen size management for better screen dimension changing support
- Improved ReplayMod support (available by installing the FFMpeg plugin)
Additions:
- Added new renderer: LTW
   - Supports incomplete OpenGL 3.2, based on OpenGL ES 3.0 (with optional features from 3.1 and 3.2)
   - Allows you to run Sodium, Iris (note that shader support is limited), Immersive Portals (GL_EXT_clip_cull_distance required), Create and most other mods for new versions of the game which previously only worked on Zink
   - Known bugs: colors may not be right in Xaero's map mods.
- Added the new "Quick Settings" menu to the in-game sidebar
   - Allows you to adjust resolution, gesture settings and gyroscope settings while the game is running.
UX changes:
- Improved default settings
- Improved download progress display for game installation

resolved.changelog: Faithful 32x – September 2026 Release Pack your bags, because Faithful 32x is ready for Minecraft 26.3! This release brings full support for the Wilderness Bound game drop, taking the new features from 26.3 to a higher resolution. The colorful poplar leaves are now supported, along with the full poplar wood set, red shrubs, shelf mushrooms, cushions, the straw bed, and the new map items and their symbols. Of course, a new update also comes with changes and fixes to older textures. Amethyst clusters and buds, melons, minecarts, and several other blocks and items have received redos and upgrades to better match the current style of the pack. A handful of issues have also been fixed across Java and Bedrock Edition. Whether you're searching abandoned camps for new maps, exploring beneath the colorful poplar trees, or settling down around a campfire, we hope you enjoy the update. As always, thank you for supporting Faithful! For the full changelog, please visit [our website](https://faithfulpack.net/faithful32x/2026-September). ![Faithful 32x promotional image showing a Minecraft player staring off into the sunset while sitting on a light blue cushion, all while being in a small outpost by an abandoned camp.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cc8f3cb07c9d5d32d4e013619fb00bb3fddbd403.jpeg)
